about: Mapping review priorities for central Skvyra (Authenticity 3.3). Curated from the 3.1/3.2 audits; every point is a reference location only - no outline may be created from a single point or from 10 m land cover. Positions WGS84 lon/lat.

items.title: Будинок земської управи (1911-1912)

points.note: Wikidata/WLM coordinate, 4 decimals (~5-10 m); lies NW of the lane in an unmapped built-up block
Commons photo IMG 20191122 155305 (WestBam, CC BY-SA 4.0): camera geotag, bearing unknown

items.photo_note: 16 files: Xsandriel 2025 (11), Kiyanka 2025 (2), WestBam 2019 (1, camera geotag), Ростислав Маленков 2007 (1), Олекса-Київ 2014 (1, CC BY-SA 3.0); all street fronts
items.why_unconfirmed: Candidate front along the lane ~35 m with 5-8 m projections vs a straight ~45 m front with shallow risalits on the photos; the WLM point is across the lane in a block with built-up land cover, no tree canopy and no outline in any source; photo geometry fits both sides.
items.needed: An outline of the real building traced from legally usable imagery or measured on site (e.g. mapped in OSM by a local mapper, or a GNSS walk-around), or a photo with camera bearing / a landmark identifying the side of the lane.

items.title: Будинок, у якому жив та працював М. Т. Рильський (дитсадок «Світанок»)
items.address: ріг вул. Максима Рильського та пров. Каштанового (Володарського); WLM: вул. Максима Рильського, 51

points.note: Wikidata/WLM coordinate, west corner of the crossing
KartaView 2019 frame with the «Світанок» plaque at arm's length (deleted sequence, not used in the model)

items.photo_note: 3 files by WestBam 2019 (CC BY-SA 4.0) with camera geotags; they show an L-shaped one-storey house
items.why_unconfirmed: The ML candidate (15 x 23 m rectangle, south corner) is the only outline within 60 m of the crossing, but the other corners of this central crossing have no outline in any source; the WLM point and the plaque photo point to the west corner.
items.needed: Outlines of the buildings on the west corner (none exist today), then a check of the L shape against the photos.

items.title: Костел Святого Яна Непомука (1885)
items.photo_note: 8 files (Xsandriel 2025 x5, Kiyanka 2025, Олекса-Київ 2014/2016): gable facade, side facade with later brick annexes; no tower
items.why_unconfirmed: The only outline is a 2,279 m2 Microsoft ML blob with 25 vertices that merges the church with neighbouring buildings; no OSM outline.
items.needed: An outline of the nave alone (single-volume hall) separated from the annexes; a footprint split cannot be invented from the blob.

items.title: Особняк Бабаєва

points.note: WLM coordinate (6 decimals), inside an ML outline

items.photo_note: 1 file (Олекса-Київ 2014, CC BY-SA 3.0); its description marks the identification as doubtful
items.why_unconfirmed: Outline position is plausible but the only photo's identification is doubtful.
items.needed: A second, independently identified photo of the building.
